detail.longDescription: My wife is doing a research study, if you're a new teacher or know a new teacher want to help an Ed.D candidate out, that would be awesome: # teacher # research # education # school # university # college --- If you are a teacher with five or fewer years of teaching experience, I would love your help with my dissertation research! I am an Ed.D. candidate at the University of Wyoming. I am conducting a research study examining novice teachers' perceptions of how well their teacher preparation programs equipped them for traditional and digital classroom management. I am looking for K-12 teachers working in public or private schools who have completed a traditional or alternative preparation pathway. The online questionnaire asks about your perceived preparedness for classroom management and your experiences during your teacher preparation program. The questionnaire should take approximately 20 minutes to complete. No personally identifying information will be collected, and your participation is completely voluntary; Qualtrics will not collect IP addresses and will anonymize your responses as well. Your participation will help build a better understanding of how teacher preparation experiences relate to novice teachers' perceived preparedness for today's traditional and technology-enhanced classrooms. The findings could help inform how future educators are prepared for the realities of teaching. Interested in participating? Click on the link below to be taken to the questionnaire! TAKE THE QUESTIONNAIRE HERE: https:// uwyo.sjc1.qualtrics.com/jfe/fo rm/SV_2hlMLcQPjTtfqqW
